scientific_role: freeze the temporal windows and burned-pilot/confirmatory partition using only response-independent island-year survey support before any species identity, detection, nondetection, annual occupancy or source-loss event is opened

window_support_rule.eligible_island: OBJECTID has surveyed=1 in all three years t0,t1,t2 of the candidate window
window_support_rule.reason: this is a response-independent survey-support floor only; biological source-loss/event estimability is adjudicated later by the burned pilot and may still STOP

window_qualification.if_fewer: STOP before any species response access; do not lower the 25-island support floor or alter window boundaries

partition_rule.burned_pilot_role: schema, event-count, class-balance, leverage-variation and model-estimability gates only; no predictive effect may count as manuscript evidence
partition_rule.confirmatory_role: only windows not assigned to burned pilot may later contribute primary source-loss leverage evidence

eligible_island_set.per_window: exact intersection of the three surveyed OBJECTID sets
eligible_island_set.reason: temporal response units are disjoint by year; repeated island identity is retained as longitudinal structure and must be handled in the later model/reference rather than removed after outcomes

next_gate_if_passed: freeze the first species-response access firewall: species identity may be routed, burned-pilot windows may open only the fields required to construct annual occupancy and source-loss estimability, confirmatory t2 outcomes remain sealed
anti_selection: do not choose overlapping three-year windows
do not move the window boundaries after SED support is seen
do not lower the 25-common-island support floor
do not assign pilot versus confirmatory windows manually
do not use species richness, detections, nondetections, source loss, persistence or leverage to qualify or rank windows
do not open the Dryad species archive before a successful v1.156 SED chain and v1.157 design freeze
